title: Portainer lists its Docker environments without signing in
summary: The Portainer API lists the Docker environments it manages to a caller with no credentials.  Portainer controls Docker, so this is control of the hosts.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_matches("^\\s*\\[\\s*\\{") and body_contains("\"Id\"") and (body_contains("\"URL\"") or body_contains("\"PublicURL\"")) and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk https://host/api/endpoints and look for a list of environments with "Id" and "URL".  /api/system/status answering is normal and is not this finding.
remediate: Never expose Portainer; require authentication and restrict the network.
